source.title: Tagger ends Krejcikova's streak to reach second Prague final

description: Austria's Lilli Tagger defeated Barbora Krejcikova 6-7 (5), 6-3, 7-6 (4) to end the Czech's eight-match winning streak and advance to her second WTA singles final at the Livesport Prague Open. Tagger will face Daria Snigur in Sunday's final.
